context_requirements: EGFR expression and ligand-dependent or autocrine EGFR signaling
EGFR addiction or activating EGFR mutation for strong response
Intact downstream negative feedback (ERK-dependent DUSP/SPRY induction)
PIK3CA wild-type and PTEN expression for sensitivity to EGFR inhibition
Epithelial phenotype; mesenchymal lines are relatively resistant
falsifiers: No induction of immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, DUSP6) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation-associated genes (MYC, CCND1, CDC20, AURKA) at 24 h
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines including HA1E
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes rather than downregulation

evidence.supports: Cetuximab induces G0-G1 arrest in sensitive colon cancer cells; PIK3CA mutation or PTEN loss confers resistance
Mesenchymal phenotype predicts resistance to EGFR inhibitors independent of EGFR mutation status
Akt activation is a convergent feature of acquired EGFR inhibitor resistance
MET pathway upregulation mediates acquired cetuximab resistance in colon cancer
EGFR inhibitor AZD9291 induces apoptosis in EGFR-mutant NSCLC via ERK suppression and Bim elevation
